draw.candidate_1: separating confounding inflation from polygenic signal by LD score regression, killed at the draw before any design
draw.dichotomy: branch A: the filed quantity (a cohort's confounding inflation, dimensionless, two decimals) is unobserved, the record carrying only the sum of confounding, signal and noise
draw.non_invariance_profile: bounded rather than flat, so the self-measurement is genuinely non-invariant, but never tight: the intercept set within two log-likelihood units is 0.0204 wide at best (2x the printed 0.01) and 0.0962 at the only range where the null region lands wrong (10x)
draw.sixth_screen: three of nine enumerated routes reach the golden besides the decisive one, all of them reading the region where the signal is absent: the bottom 5 per cent of LD score, the bottom quintile, and the inflation factor on the lowest decile
draw.rule_earned: an identification of the form 'estimate the nuisance where the signal vanishes' fails the sixth screen by construction, because the region where the signal vanishes publishes the nuisance and the leverage that sharpens the identification is what purifies that region
draw.candidate_2: fine-mapping which variant in a locus is causal, killed at the draw. Under the standard single-causal model the causal variant has the largest expected z, so the lead can differ from it in only three ways and each was measured: equal power and one causal variant means the answer IS the lead, so lead-by-p-value and largest-absolute-effect both reach it and the standard pipeline is the golden; a poorly imputed causal variant splits the family (ABF, sum-of-single-effects and stepwise name variant 5, stochastic search names 7) and argmin(INFO) publishes the answer; two causal variants split the family again and make the well-posed answer a set rather than a name.
draw.rule_earned_2: the perturbation that separates the lead variant from the causal one is the perturbation the licensed methods disagree about, so the method family closes only when the answer is trivial; and where the well-posed answer to which-one is a set, grading a name grades an arbitrary element of it.

resume: PAUSED at stage 1 with two candidates banked and no card ever registered, so no parallel build is guarded against a draw that does not exist. Not retired and never will be. Candidate 1, a cohort's confounding inflation recovered by regression on a linkage covariate, died on the sixth screen at four measured settings with no window between them: widened, the nuisance was pinned to twice the printed precision while the lowest covariate bin alone named the answer; narrowed, that bin named the wrong candidate and the profile ballooned to ten times the printed precision. Three of nine enumerated routes reached the golden and all three were the same move. Candidate 2, fine-mapping, died on all three conditions, one branch each: with equal power the causal variant is the lead by construction so two sorted columns reach it and the standard pipeline is the golden; with the causal variant poorly imputed the method family splits three to one on the graded name and argmin of the imputation column publishes the answer; with two causal variants the family splits again and the well-posed answer is a set rather than a name. The ground's remaining affordances were ruled out on paper and are recorded in the note. Whoever resumes it reads the note first and starts at stage 1 on a different ground.
